navigation.flow: Navigation, scope selection, logout; local navigation is synchronous; project loading and logout display pending/error/retry. Global Admin project read does not create membership.
navigation.readback: ProjectProvider reloads current identity/project; scope comes from projectId query and selected project.
navigation.tests: admin-routing, admin-role-compatibility, ProjectProvider, projects settings tests; native AdminWorkspace assertions pending combined run

read.flow: Filters reset pagination; reload/retry uses current key and abort/stale generation protection. Paging disabled at bounds. Read failures remain visible; successful navigation/read has no write success requirement.
read.backend: AdminAuditService, AdminOverviewService, AdminProjectService; ADMIN controller authorization
read.readback: Current project/membership/status/asset projections, sanitized actor/entity audit response.
read.tests: admin.test, status-reports audit retries, AdminOverviewServiceTest, AdminAuditServiceTest

picker.flow: Select/search/paging controls update local scope or draft; named labels and loading/error/retry path. Current-account role constrains project role options. No write from picking alone.
picker.readback: Selected project label fetched independently when not on current page; membership role validated again on write.

project.flow: Create/edit/member saves validate required fields and role compatibility. Mutation disables fieldsets; partial member saves remove fulfilled rows and retain failed/unattempted rows. Retry obtains current version. Generation/key guards isolate project/editor completion. Summary reload now refreshes management/lifecycle too.
project.backend: AdminManagementController, AdminProjectManagementService; ADMIN, enabled account, last enabled PM, optimistic version/project locks
project.readback: Versioned projects/current enabled memberships, summary and lifecycle reload on revision; initial device allocations in same create transaction.
project.tests: admin-projects, admin-management, AdminProjectLifecycle.integration (reload RED→GREEN), AdminNativeIntegrationTest, CentralMembershipTest

lifecycle.flow: Archive/reopen dialogs show readiness/history, reason validation, pending, conflict/error retry preserving reason, and saved status. Pending unsaved changes explained before lifecycle transition. Archived state disables writes; receive asset remains possible.
lifecycle.backend: ProjectLifecycleService; ADMIN, version/lock, active allocation blockers, idempotent actor/payload request key
lifecycle.tests: AdminProjectLifecycle tests, lifecycle native tests owned by root; read source evidence only for unexecuted checks

users.flow: Create/status/permission controls display validation, busy, error and success; preserve draft on failure, reload current data on stale version. Account creation role options constrained; status last-PM failure remains visible.
users.backend: AdminIdentityService, IdentityService; ADMIN or separately authorized PM may create TESTER only; versions, identity-before-project locking, last enabled PM guard
users.readback: identity_users and current memberships; response excludes password/hash.

dialog.flow: Modal focus/escape/backdrop and inline form focus restoration; busy prevents dismissal. Validation focuses message/invalid field; pending and response handled by owning form.
dialog.api: No direct API; delegates form actions
dialog.tests: admin-dialog, device-editor-focus, shared useDialogFocus regressions reviewed

inventory.flow: Create/edit/assign/return validate required values and recipient. Bulk recipient applies only selected rows; missing-recipient count and jump visible. Failed handover retains failed/unattempted rows; fulfilled rows removed and authoritative stock reloaded. Busy prevents duplicate submit; stale editor completion isolated; success/error and retry version shown.
inventory.backend: DeviceInventoryService; ADMIN; asset version, active enabled project recipient, archive guard for assignment; return allowed for archived project; sorted asset/project locking
inventory.readback: device_assets status/version and device_allocations sole active allocation via generated unique key; project summary refresh.
inventory.tests: inventory, button-recheck, device-handover-feedback, NativeInitialAllocationTest, native 20-handover test owned by root

progress.flow: History paging/retry; workspace canPost gates form, busy prevents duplicate submit. Failed draft/idempotency key retained; keyed project prevents old completion erasing new draft. Central history has direct selected-project workspace link. Admin global canPost true only active workspace; central stays readonly.
progress.backend: ProjectStatusReportService; current ADMIN or active project PM, enabled actor, project lock/archive guard; ProjectActorService inactive attribution for global Admin
progress.readback: Append-only project_status_reports and audit, actor-bound request key; actual author identity preserved; warnings computed from actual milestones.
progress.tests: status-reports 6 GREEN with new navigation RED→GREEN; ProjectStatusReportTest 8 GREEN; AdminWorkspaceNative new author/readback pending

catalog.flow: Tab/filter/toggle/new/edit actions; required native validation and visible form alert; pending/error/retry and saved notice. Editor cancel guards pending; version/state refreshed after mutation. Builds show active choices, explicit date clear preserved.
catalog.backend: CatalogController/Service/Store; global Admin/current PM policy, project scope, archive write guard, version/project lock; normalized build uniqueness
catalog.readback: project_environments/device_types/milestones/builds; scoped identifiers, versioned responses and refreshed lists.
catalog.tests: CatalogPage, CatalogInputTest; no native catalog write performed in this pass

handbook.flow: List/detail/history selection with loading/error/retry; create/new version required validation, pending/error and saved status. Versions immutable; local draft retained after failure.
handbook.backend: HandbookController/Service; current Admin/PM, active project, current revision expected ID/project lock
handbook.readback: project_resources + resource_revisions project-scoped current revision FK; append-only revision history; content rendered as text.
handbook.tests: settings tests; backend source trace; no new handbook native mutation in this pass

rules.flow: Reload/new draft/publish; required names, schema JSON error, busy/error/saved notice. Publish uses current version and immutable version list.
rules.backend: InternalRuleController/Service; Admin/PM, project archive guard, validated declarative schema, version/project lock
rules.readback: internal_rule_sets/versions and scoped current_version_id; no arbitrary evaluator code.

settings.flow: Settings fields save with busy/error/success/version reload; central member management link. Legacy MemberEditor exists but current settings intentionally passes canEdit=false. Legacy CreateProjectDialog has no production caller; API directs centralized creation, so reviewed dead legacy form is not a reachable create route.
settings.backend: ProjectController/Service, AdminProjectManagementService; Admin/current project PM, enabled role compatibility, last enabled PM/version/project scope
settings.readback: Current project summary and memberships refreshed after successful mutation; role/archive capability checks.
